name: Ho Chi Minh Thought
scope: Ho Chi Minh Thought as the Communist Party of Vietnam defines it: 'a comprehensive and profound system of views on the basic issues of the Vietnamese revolution, from the people's national democratic revolution to the socialist revolution', the creative application of Marxism-Leninism to Vietnam that also draws on national tradition and world culture, aiming at national, class and human liberation and national independence tied to socialism (the official state textbook, s1, quoting the Party's 9th Congress; the Party's own account, s3). It is the Party's codified system, not a record of everything Ho Chi Minh said, so his own texts count only where the defining sources tie them to it (Bản án chế độ thực dân Pháp, Đường Kách mệnh, Sửa đổi lối làm việc, the Declaration of Independence, the Testament). Generic Marxism-Leninism, Vietnamese nationalism and the Party's later Đổi Mới policy are not this subject's sources.

summary: Local phase: the official national textbook states a few positions outright (revolutionary violence, the Party's exclusive leading role, vanguard party, democratic centralism, self-determination, reunification, independence tied to socialism); everything else the local texts do not settle stays null for the web phase. Sửa Đổi Lối Làm Việc was added as a key work but not yet mined.
